subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 08, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 08, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS community,

We're starting the week off with a bang, thanks to the recent kernel updates from the Linux community. Greg Kroah-Hartman has announced the release of the 7.2.4 and 6.2.4 kernels, which we've incorporated into our stable kernel builds. This means you can expect improved performance and security for your AcreetionOS system.

In other news, Buildroot 2026.08 has been released, bringing with it a host of new features and improvements. We're excited to see the impact this will have on our project, and we're working hard to integrate these changes into our own codebase.

On the development front, we've been busy pushing out commits and fixing issues. Our team has been working tirelessly to ensure that AcreetionOS remains a stable and secure platform for our users. We've also been making progress on our wiki guides and newsletter archive, which will be available soon.

We're also pleased to announce that we've fixed a few issues with our release process, including a problem with the block-scalar indentation in our workflow validation. This should make things smoother for our users and developers alike.

In other news, we've added Firefox-UBlock-Origin to our Xlibre build, which should provide an extra layer of protection for our users. We're always looking for ways to improve the security and functionality of AcreetionOS, and this is just one example of our ongoing efforts.

We're also happy to report that our GitLab mirror has been fixed, and we're re-triggering the deployment key. This should ensure that our code is up-to-date and easily accessible for our developers.

As always, we're grateful for the support and contributions of our community. Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable to us, and we're always looking for ways to improve AcreetionOS.

We're excited to see what the rest of the week brings, and we're looking forward to continuing our work on this project. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our Discord server or through our GitHub repository.

Thanks for being part of the AcreetionOS community, and we'll see you in the next update!

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
